notes.title: Release notes for 8/5/2023
notes.notes:
New sights for M4 Carbine
 Option to move straight to the next mission
 Weapon adjustments

notes.title: Major content update
notes.notes:
In past weeks a lot of things has changed in the game.

One of key issues in this update is the audio system, we have added footstep and ambient nature sounds and other audios for interacting the world.

Also gameplay UI has been re-organized, and for guidance, we added objective system, so you can now see your current objective.

We should mention the gas stoves, that we added to bottoms of enemies, and sounds which makes hearing enemies much easier. Also grenade physics are now way better.

As minor issues, enemy AI and player's weapon system has been improved, and slight fixes to maps has been made as well.

It should be more fun to crash the capsules now. If you have something to comment, please add your opinion to discussions section.

notes.title: Major environment update
notes.notes:
Our major environment update finally made it out!

Update includes: 
- New forest / trees
- Foliages
- Loading screen optimized
- Foliage on/off option in settings

Big environment update is made by updating all tree and adding extra detail with foliage like grass and ferns. Foliages added little bit of extra performance cost, so we added option to turn off and on foliages from settings.
